prompt: Create an original 150 second Chinese plucked-string ensemble instrumental composition for nature documentary, landscape and gentle exploration. Mood: organic, open, fresh. Instruments: pipa, yangqin, dizi, frame drum. Style: crisp plucked ostinato with bright bamboo-flute answers. Tempo approximately 102 BPM; D dorian. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Introduce a gently rising motif and a sense of open air. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: A serene and traditional East Asian instrumental piece featuring a prominent guzheng-like plucked string melody, accompanied by a gentle flute and subtle percussion. The mood is calm and contemplative.
description.zh: 一首宁静的东亚传统器乐曲，以古筝般的弹拨弦乐器为主旋律，辅以悠扬的笛子和轻柔的打击乐。氛围平静而富有沉思感。
